You, You Make Me
You, You Make Me
You, You Make Me
You, You Make Me


Fallen too deep 
Trying to swim 
The current to steep and it’s pulling me in 
I can breathe 
Both hands around my heart 
My heart 

I can still feel 
The heat on your skin 
My lips are begging to pull you in 
I can breathe 
your hands around my heart 
My heart 


I’mma hold the the door 
For you there ain’t no cure 
I know 
That I could wait a life 
And still find you on both sides 
And we’d be right back here 

(On both sides) 

You, You Make Me

You, You Make Me
Both hands round my heart, my heart
You, You Make Me
Both hands round my heart, I’m yours
